facts.label: Discurso indireto com told
facts.sub: Use told + pessoa + (that) + passado: She told me she was leaving. O that é opcional. Com said não use pessoa: She said she was leaving.

facts.label: Told + pessoa
facts.sub: Com told, diga sempre quem ouviu: told me, told him, told us. She told me she was leaving. Não diga she told that. Para a mesma ideia sem pessoa, use said: She said she was leaving.

facts.label: That é opcional
facts.sub: Depois de told me, o that é opcional: She told me that she was leaving. She told me she was leaving. Na fala, quase todos omitem o that. Na escrita, use o que soar melhor.

facts.label: Verbos voltam
facts.sub: O verbo vai um passo para trás: am/is → was, are → were, want → wanted, will → would, can → could. She told me she wanted a change.

facts.label: Pronomes mudam
facts.sub: Mude os pronomes: I vira he ou she, we vira they. “I am leaving” vira She told me she was leaving. E me, him, us mudam conforme quem ouviu a notícia.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: We say “She told me she was leaving”.
We say “She told she was leaving”.
items.why: Told needs a person: told me.
We say said or told me.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: We say “She told me she was leaving”. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “She told she was leaving”. → Falso (Told needs a person: told me.)
“She said me” is correct. → Falso (We say said or told me.)

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 2/2

items.s: After told me, the verb goes back in time.
Told me that and told me are both correct.

Told me that and told me are both correct. → Verdadeiro (Yes, that is optional.)
